paragraphs.text: 1. ALLIED with thee in friendship, Indra, these, thy priests, remembering Holy Law, rent Vrtra limb from limb,
paragraphs.original: तव त्य इन्द्र सख्येषु वह्नय ऋतं मन्वाना व्यदर्दिरुर्वलम् ।
paragraphs.translit: tava tya indra sakhyeṣu vahnaya ṛtaṃ manvānā vyadardirurvalam |

paragraphs.text: When they bestowed the Dawns and let the waters flow, and when thou didst chastise dragons at Kutsa's call.
paragraphs.original: यत्रा दशस्यन्नुषसो रिणन्नपः कुत्साय मन्मन्नह्यश्च दंसयः
paragraphs.translit: yatrā daśasyannuṣaso riṇannapaḥ kutsāya manmannahyaśca daṃsayaḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Thou sentest forth productive powers, clavest the hills, thou dravest forth the kine, thou drankest pleasant meath.
paragraphs.original: अवासृजः प्रस्वः श्वञ्चयो गिरीनुदाज उस्रा अपिबो मधु प्रियम् ।
paragraphs.translit: avāsṛjaḥ prasvaḥ śvañcayo girīnudāja usrā apibo madhu priyam |

paragraphs.text: Thou gavest increase through this Tree's surpassing might. The Sun shone by the hymn that sprang from Holy Law.
paragraphs.original: अवर्धयो वनिनो अस्य दंससा शुशोच सूर्य ऋतजातया गिरा
paragraphs.translit: avardhayo vanino asya daṃsasā śuśoca sūrya ṛtajātayā girā

paragraphs.text: 3. In the mid-way of heaven the Sun unyoked his car: the Arya found a match to meet his Dam foe.
paragraphs.original: वि सूर्यो मध्ये अमुचद्रथं दिवो विदद्दासाय प्रतिमानमार्यः ।
paragraphs.translit: vi sūryo madhye amucadrathaṃ divo vidaddāsāya pratimānamāryaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Associate with Rjisvan Indra overthrew the solid forts of Pipru, conjuring Asura.
paragraphs.original: दृळ्हानि पिप्रोरसुरस्य मायिन इन्द्रो व्यास्यच्चकृवाँ ऋजिश्वना
paragraphs.translit: dṛḷhāni piprorasurasya māyina indro vyāsyaccakṛvām̐ ṛjiśvanā

paragraphs.text: 4. He boldly cast down forts which none had e'er assailed: unwearied he destroyed the godless treasure-stores.
Like Sun and Moon he took the stronghold's wealth away, and, praised in song, demolished foes with flashing dart.
paragraphs.original: मासेव सूर्यो वसु पुर्यमा ददे गृणानः शत्रूँरशृणाद्विरुक्मता
paragraphs.translit: māseva sūryo vasu puryamā dade gṛṇānaḥ śatrūm̐raśṛṇādvirukmatā

paragraphs.text: 5. Armed with resistless weapons, with vast power to cleave, the Vrtra-slayer whets his darts and deals fordi wounds.
paragraphs.original: अयुद्धसेनो विभ्वा विभिन्दता दाशद्वृत्रहा तुज्यानि तेजते ।
paragraphs.translit: ayuddhaseno vibhvā vibhindatā dāśadvṛtrahā tujyāni tejate |

paragraphs.text: Bright Usas was afraid of Indra's slaughtering bolt: she went upon her way and left her chariot there.
6. These are thy famous exploits, only thine, when thou alone hast left the other bereft of sacrifice.
paragraphs.original: एता त्या ते श्रुत्यानि केवला यदेक एकमकृणोरयज्ञम् ।
paragraphs.translit: etā tyā te śrutyāni kevalā yadeka ekamakṛṇorayajñam |

paragraphs.text: Thou in the heavens hast set the ordering of the Moons: the Father bears the felly portioned out by thee.
paragraphs.original: मासां विधानमदधा अधि द्यवि त्वया विभिन्नं भरति प्रधिं पिता
paragraphs.translit: māsāṃ vidhānamadadhā adhi dyavi tvayā vibhinnaṃ bharati pradhiṃ pitā
